author: Jason Stys
summary: Build authenticated read-only release dossiers with verified bundle/registry agreement, recorded quality gates, bounded history and matching drift context. Fixed SQLite handle leaks.
rationale: Gives model reviewers explicit evidence and uncertainty before an independent promotion or rollback decision.
limitations: Synthetic controlled operator-token lab, not multi-user production model-release authority.
Dossiers verify bundle/registry metadata; they do not reread all raw dataset bytes or independently rerun recorded evaluations.
No promotion/rollback occurs; history is capped at 100 entries with truncation explicit, and previous rollback candidates remain unverified.
The 100-sample drift heuristic is not statistical confidence and the captured snapshot can become stale.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
